question: "As of 1st January 2021, how many times has India been elected to the UN Security Council as a nonpermanent member?"
solution:
The correct answer is **Eight times**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** has been elected to the UN Security Council as a non-permanent member **eight times** as of 1st January 2021.
 
• The most recent term started in **2021** and will end in **2022**.
 
• India's previous terms were in **1950-51, 1967-68, 1972-73, 1977-78, 1984-85, 1991-92, and 2011-12**.
 
• The UN Security Council consists of **15 members**, including 5 permanent members and 10 non-permanent members.
